prompt: Tell me about Philippo di Vadi
response: Philloppo di Vadi was a 15th-century Italian fencing master who authored the treatise "De Arte Gladiatoria Dimicandi". He was known for his work in the field of historical fencing and his contributions to the development of Italian fencing styles. Vadi's treatise is notable for its detailed illustrations and explanations of fencing techniques. He was influenced by the works of earlier masters and contributed to the fencing tradition through his teachings and writings.
